The editorial illustration for Tempo magazine, dated 9-15 Oktober 2017, uses a limited color palette of red, navy blue, and cream. The background features a red sunburst pattern with radial lines and a halftone dot effect. At the top, the large cream-colored word "TEMPO" is centered. Below it, smaller text reads "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU".

The central focus is three stylized hands rising from the bottom, each gripping a firearm pointing upward. These weapons, rendered in navy blue and cream, resemble grenade launchers with ribbed barrels and large triggers. The central hand holds its weapon vertically, while the hands on the left and right hold their weapons at slight outward angles. 

A cream-colored diagonal banner overlays the center, containing the large navy blue text "SENJATA MAKANAN TUAN". Smaller text below it reads: "PENGADAAN PELONTAR GRANAT UNTUK BRIMOB POLRI BERLANGSUNG JANGGAL. DITENGARAI DIATUR SEBELUM PROSES TENDER." 

Additional text at the top includes "MAIN POLISI NASABAH ALLIANZ" and "IQRA: KISAH TIGA PENYAIR LEKRA". A barcode and pricing information are in the bottom-left corner.
